editorial:
Imagine finding out your dad didn't just leave you as a kid, but was actually part of something truly evil. That is exactly what happens here when a woman finds out her father's body has been discovered after 36 years at a crime scene that looks like a nightmare. You will feel the tension right away as she digs into his old life and realizes the man she thought she knew was a complete stranger. It feels like a dark puzzle where every piece you find makes the story even scarier and more confusing.

The acting is top notch and the twists really hit hard when you least expect them. While the middle part slows down a bit, the ending makes up for it with a wild payoff. If you love mysteries that keep you guessing, you need to see this.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the father was not the victim, but the leader of a cult. He faked his death to watch his daughter from afar for decades. In the final scene, you see that the body found was actually a clone he created through a dark ritual. He finally reveals himself in the basement, but the daughter manages to burn the house down, killing him and ending the family curse for good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark family secrets and scary mysteries.
